harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false override), rebuilt the initramfs so the block is enforced at boot, verified modprobe cannot load the module, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until exec was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified post-reboot that usb-storage is still absent and modprobe still fails to load it.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/module state and existing modprobe.d blacklist files (cmd-00737b8efea34644)
Confirmed modprobe usb-storage fails immediately due to the install override, both normal and forced load (cmd-5f9448e6f3304068)
Ran update-initramfs -u -k all to bake the blacklist into the boot image (cmd-9595c73b0b10487d)
Verified /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf is present inside the new initramfs (cmd-4df70d7e507d49c8)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime_since, module-not-loaded status, and modprobe dry-run (cmd-f169f06133764677)
Issued sudo reboot on node1 in background, disconnecting the exec stream as acknowledgement (cmd-de995cf0a09940e2)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming the node returned (cmd-7ddf86ddaf2c4d78 timeout, cmd-787a65e897cc4834 success)
Captured post-restart boot_id (changed) and re-verified module still blocked, config still present, modprobe still fails (cmd-f3edba0de0d34a03)

evidence.summary: Blacklist config created and modprobe usb-storage (including forced) fails with 'Invalid argument' due to the install /bin/false override, proving it cannot load at runtime.

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module load prevented after reboot (persistent)
evidence.summary: initramfs rebuilt and confirmed to contain the blacklist config; after actual reboot, modprobe usb-storage still fails and the module remains unloaded, plus the config file is intact.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, module state)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=28ae5f98... and uptime_since, confirming usb_storage not loaded before restart.
sudo reboot issued and exec stream disconnected as acknowledgement that the restart command executed before disconnecting the node.
Polling showed a connection timeout during reboot, then successful exec once the node came back up.

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just service restart)
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id=b931f7ed... differs from the pre-restart boot_id=28ae5f98..., proving the kernel actually restarted.
After reboot, usb_storage remains unloaded, the blacklist config file is present and unchanged, and modprobe usb-storage still fails as intended.

attempts.summary: On node1, blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false override), rebuilt the initramfs so the block is enforced at boot, verified modprobe cannot load the module, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until exec was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified post-reboot that usb-storage is still absent and modprobe still fails to load it.
